decisions.reason: As a small accessory tied directly to the trailer business, it is less strategic than full trailer lines but still a useful complementary product the firm would likely retain after only one year.
A box car trailer series is core to a trailer manufacturer’s portfolio and its home-page placement suggests the firm sees it as an important commercial offering.
A car transporter trailer fits the company’s established vehicle-trailer competence and would usually be given more time in the market before any withdrawal decision.
A low-bed trailer series is a substantial core product for this type of manufacturer and its prominent website placement points to continued support.
A high trailer cover series is a natural add-on within the firm’s trailer range and is likely to stay because it broadens the usable configurations of existing trailers.
Although another box car trailer series creates some overlap risk, a medium-sized German manufacturer would usually keep a newly launched series on the market longer before rationalizing the range.
